climatePeriods.message: Climate periods: baseline 2009–2023; dataset reference 1976–2005; MISMATCH. Climate signal has not been rebased; review this limitation when interpreting results.

requestedProducts.disclosurePolicy: fwg-ensemble-disclosure-v1: small ensemble means fewer than 3 products; this is a disclosure rule, not a scientific confidence threshold
notices: Spread describes the selected products; it is not a calibrated probability interval or total projection uncertainty.

membershipPolicy: Scenario manifests identify actual used products. No silent substitution; run selection is not proof every case completed.

interpretation: SolarQC may retain source radiation. The processed control applies the scenario methods with zero climate change. Processing differences do not establish observational accuracy. Compare each future output with its matched control.

solarQc.outcome: Accepted after SolarQC correction. The original EPW did not pass unchanged; FWG generated and revalidated a corrected baseline for morphing.
solarQc.photometricClosureScope: N16-N18 only; N19 validity is reported separately

solarGeometry.interpretation: Production solar geometry agrees closely with the independent reference; decomposition spread is reported as model-form dispersion, not a confidence interval.
solarGeometry.scope: Analytical solar-position agreement only; not overall weather accuracy.

modelFormDispersion.comparisonPolicy: Eight constrained individual models on a common valid-record mask; dependent ensemble excluded from dispersion.
modelFormDispersion.interpretation: Candidate spread is model-form dispersion and is not a calibrated probabilistic confidence interval.
